message.content: {"reason": "Current accuracy 0.7645 is plateaued across three heterogeneous learners with near-identical fold scores, indicating a shared feature-representation ceiling rather than a model or blend problem: the pipeline only supplies raw categorical levels and frequency (rarity) encodings, so trees must reconstruct conditional coupon×context acceptance means through deep splits on ~8.1k rows and the linear/FM branches cannot express them at all. The fix therefore belongs in data_processing_and_feature_engineering (supervised compression of the coupon×context interaction manifold into ~11 smoothed OOF target-encoded scalars) and in training_evaluation (leakage-safe fold wiring, full-train refit, and bundle persistence/reload). The failed historical target-encoding attempt shows the risk is not the idea but the wiring — replacing GBDT's native categorical codes with TE values and encoding single columns only — so this refinement adds interaction-key TE as a supplementary numeric block, keeps native categorical handling intact, and reuses the successful historical pattern of persisting every fitted artifact (maps, prior, smoothing k, key/column order) in the bundle and reloading read-only at predict.", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Add a leakage-safe smoothed OOF target-encoding block to CouponFeatureEngineer covering the curated coupon-centric interaction keys — coupon, coupon×occupation, coupon×age_ord, coupon×time, coupon×expiration, coupon×has_children, coupon×distance_level, coupon×coupon_venue_visited, coupon×is_25min, coupon×income_ord_bucket, coupon×venue_freq_bucket — using encoded = (sum_y + k·prior)/(cnt + k) with k≈20 and a global training prior for unseen/NaN keys. WHY: the signal here is almost entirely conditional (Bar×Student×10PM vs CoffeeHouse×Retired×7AM), so per-segment acceptance propensity is the single most informative low-dimensional statistic; it converts hundreds of sparse tree splits into ~11 near-monotone features and gives the LR/FM branches an expressive linear term. HOW: build and cache the key columns inside _build_base (or a new _build_te_keys helper) so train and predict derive identical key strings, add fit_target_encoding(y, fold_ids, k=20) that (a) computes per-key smoothed means from training rows only, (b) emits out-of-fold values for training rows using the existing StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, random_state=42) fold ids so a row's own label never enters its encoding, and (c) exposes transform_target_encoding(df) applying saved maps with fallback to the stored prior; store te_maps_, te_prior_, te_k_, te_key_cols_, te_col_names_ on the engineer so they serialize with it. CRITICAL: do NOT replace raw integer categorical columns — append the TE values as an additional numeric block so GBDT keeps native categorical dtype and DeepFM keeps its embedding cards; preserve fit/transform/fit_transform/save/load signatures, categorical_columns/numeric_columns semantics (numeric_columns now includes te_* names), and the existing _prepare_features reindex/NaN-fill contract.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Wire the interaction-key TE into the existing fold loop, full-data refit, bundle persistence, and fresh-process predict without changing the StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, random_state=42) split, seeds (per-fold fi, LGB 0/1/2, FM seed 0), model architectures, LightGBM/LR hyperparameters, threshold grid (0.20–0.80, 61 points), max(lgb, stack) selection rule, or row_id/prediction output format. WHY: TE features help only if training rows see fold-internal encodings while the final models and prediction use full-train maps loaded read-only — the prior failed attempt shows that replacing GBDT categorical codes with TE and refitting at predict are the two failure modes to avoid, whereas the successful runs show persisting all fitted state (feature order, categorical vocabularies, maps, prior, threshold, label_map) is what keeps predict self-contained and leakage-free. HOW: inside run_training compute fold_ids from the existing folds, call fe.fit_target_encoding(y, fold_ids) on the full engineer then, per fold, build a fold engineer whose TE maps are refit on features.iloc[tr] only and applied to both tr and va before _prepare_features (so X_num gains the te_* columns for both branches); after OOF stacking/threshold selection, refit TE on all training rows for the final_* models and for the persisted fe. Extend the bundle dict with explicit 'te_maps', 'te_prior', 'te_k', 'te_key_cols', 'te_col_names' keys alongside the existing fe/cat_cols/num_cols/cat_maps/scaler/card/lgb_models/lr_model/meta_model/use_stack/threshold/label_map, keep fm.pt unchanged except n_numeric reflecting the wider X_num. In run_predict load the bundle, call fe.transform() then transform_target_encoding() using only saved maps (never refit, prior fallback for unseen keys), and rebuild X_num in the exact persisted num_cols order so feature alignment is guaranteed; keep numerical coercion/NaN-fill, mean-over-three-LGB averaging, stack path, threshold application, and label_map inverse mapping unchanged."}}
message.reasoning_content:
We need to produce JSON with reason, module array, plan object. Modules: data_processing_and_feature_engineering and training_evaluation. The initial plan is about OOF smoothed target encoding for coupon interaction keys, plus wiring into fold loop and persistence.

Refine based on historical experiments: successful ones persisted all fitted state in bundle, leakage-safe fold-internal encoding, multi-seed refit, threshold tuning on OOF. Failed one also attempted target encoding but failed — likely because it replaced raw categorical integer codes with TE values in GBDT, losing categorical native handling, and encoding per-column not interaction keys, and possibly leakage/wiring issues. So refine: keep raw categorical columns as native categoricals in LightGBM, ADD the TE block as extra numeric features rather than replacing; compute interaction keys explicitly in engineer; use fold-internal OOF encodings with the same seed 42 folds; persist maps, prior, smoothing k, key definitions, and column names in bundle; predict applies saved maps with prior fallback.

Write plan strings 2-5 sentences each.
